notes: Upgraded from attested (6 stored batch files under research/t5_rank4/) to a self-contained verified certificate (exact: true, 7.1 s on a single core under the default budget, zero external files, zero floating-point arithmetic). Slicing along qubits 1, 2: (1) Fact 1 (every term full along every qubit) is verified in exact Z[i] arithmetic on the unique rank-3 decomposition orbit of |T>^4, whose 262,144-entry residual tables at tau^{+-1} have 0 exact and 0 stabilizer hits; (2) Fact 2 (at most 1 absent term at any 2-qubit point) holds from chi(T^3) = 3; (3) the flat lemma and exact integer residual tables on the 4 G_3-orbits of rank-3 decompositions of |T>^3 at tau^{+-2} (0 exact hits) exclude any B-line term (n_B = 0), forcing all 4 terms to be visible at x_0 = 00; (4) the 1-pivot codimension-2 Galois quotient on D_3 (1,080 states, |G_3| = 162) enumerates all 2,372 Kind-A independent 4-cover orbits, 0 Kind-B dependent 4-cover orbits (max parallel ray group in Q(i)^8 / P_3 is 3 < 4), and 8 Kind-C repeated-state 4-cover orbits; (5) every Kind-C orbit is eliminated in exact Z[i] arithmetic by projecting its 1,089 slice-11 residuals onto the 8 orthogonal Pauli classes {P_k u_blk}_{k=0}^7 (minimum non-zero Pauli support is 4 > 2); (6) exact integer meet-in-the-middle slice matching across x in {01, 10, 11} leaves 196 slice-01 survivors and 0 5-qubit survivors.
